lines.text: They stay in one house until they leave that area, and call down fire on towns that reject them.

wrong_details.wrong: call down fire on towns that reject them
wrong_details.true: shake the dust off your feet

problems.problem: Its true detail "shake the dust off their feet" isn't in Luke 9:5 word for word.
Its wrong detail "tear their cloaks" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
